data.summary: Gartencenter Beispielblüte sent a payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) for the delivery and planting of 6 fruit trees in October 2026, requesting payment of the outstanding total of €537.00 by 4 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is a reminder from the garden center that an invoice for planting fruit trees in your garden has not yet been paid. The amount owed is €534.00 for the work plus a €3.00 reminder fee, totalling €537.00. Please check your records to see if you already paid; if so, you can ignore this letter as it says. Otherwise, transfer the amount to the IBAN given by the stated deadline to avoid further reminder fees or collection steps.
